indexEntry.title: Graduate Diploma (GDip) in Business and Entrepreneurship (Type 3/Direct-entry)

record.graduateDiplomaCourseRequirementsRichTex:
• Students are required to successfully complete any 6 courses from the BE course series for the GDip. BET 580, BET 600 and BET 700 level courses are also eligible to be counted towards the 6 course GDip requirement. However, BET 600 and BET 700 courses are restricted to students enrolled in the MBET program.
  • Students who complete 3 BE courses as part of another graduate qualification may apply to receive a Graduate Certificate of Participation from the Conrad School. Alternatively, they may apply for admission to the GDip program, successfully complete an additional 3 courses, and be awarded the GDip. A student may receive the Graduate Certificate of Participation, or the GDip, but not both. Similarly, BET courses can be counted towards only one graduate certification, diploma or degree.

record.admissionRequirements:
• A four year undergraduate Honours degree or equivalent from a recognized university.
  • In the case of a three year undergraduate degree or equivalent from a recognized university, a minimum of four years of industry experience may be considered for admission into the program.
  • A minimum average of 75% in the last two years of study.
  • English language proficiency (ELP) (if applicable)
record.degreeRequirementsGrad: • Students must complete the course requirements listed below in addition to the Graduate Academic Integrity Module (Graduate AIM).
